svg.text: Provably SAT / UNSAT Hamiltonian Cycle Graphs (HAMD / HCP)
Locally indistinguishable 3-regular, 3-connected graph instances encoded via O(|E| log N) binary-order MTZ CNF
Suite Coverage (22 instances · 12 SAT / 10 UNSAT): Gen. Petersen GP(n,2), Flower Snarks J₅/J₇, Meredith G₃/G₄, Chvátal t<1, Broken Crowns Bₙ,ₖ, Planted Random.
CNF Encoding: Directed 1-factor (∑out=1, ∑in=1) + no 2-cycles + binary-order MTZ rank (aᵤ→ᵥ ⇒ rᵤ < rᵥ); vertices randomly permuted to hide structure.
